model_traces.assistant_text: I'll start with the bound order's actual lifecycle state — an HTTP 200 read alone doesn't tell us whether the async notification is even due yet.

args.reason: Establish current order lifecycle/state; 200 read alone doesn't prove completion or that a callback is due.
Order is COMPLETED at version 2; now need the correlated callback event, its order/delivery version and actual transport acknowledgement.

model_traces.assistant_text: I'll verify the receiver-side processing state — the delivery event shows transport-level `ACKNOWLEDGED` (202), but an acknowledgement is not proof that the receiver finished processing.

args.reason: Delivery event v2 for completed order shows 202 ACKNOWLEDGED; need receiver processing state since ACK != completed processing.
